functions.name: RushDuel.AttachAtkDef

params.name: e
params.description: Resolving source effect; its handler owns the modifiers.

params.name: atk
params.description: ATK delta or value callback; nil and numeric 0 skip this branch.

params.name: def
params.description: DEF delta or value callback; nil and numeric 0 skip this branch, and RD.IsCanChangeDef must pass.

params.name: reset
params.description: Explicit reset mask shared by both modifiers. Omitting it adds no reset policy.

params.name: forced
params.description: Passed to Card.RegisterEffect. Normally omit it rather than bypassing immunity.

description_zh: 赋予: 攻守升降
description_en: Registers a single-card EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK effect for nonzero, non-nil atk, and an EFFECT_UPDATE_DEFENSE effect for nonzero, non-nil def only when RD.IsCanChangeDef(card) passes. That predicate is card:IsDefenseAbove(0) and not RD.IsMaximumMode(card): it requires the core's valid, nonnegative DEF check and excludes Maximum-mode monsters. It does not block the ATK branch.

Both modifiers are created through RD.CreateSingleEffect with e:GetHandler() as owner, FLAG_ATTACH_EFFECT as label, and the supplied reset/forced values. No automatic duration is added when reset is omitted. Pass RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD+RESET_PHASE+PHASE_END for the usual until-End-Phase card modifier.
This helper returns no values and does not report whether the card's final stats changed. forced is passed to Card.RegisterEffect; leave it nil/false for normal effect-immunity handling.

functions.name: RushDuel.CanSelectAndDoAction

params.name: filter
params.description: Card predicate including required action-legality checks.

params.name: expect
params.description: Card(s) excluded from matching; pass nil for none.

params.name: action
params.description: Called as action(selected_group) after the player accepts and completes selection.

returns.description: Exactly the callback's return values when invoked; otherwise numeric 0. A callback may return no values.

description_zh: 可选操作: 选择匹配卡片
description_en: Optional resolution action: finds candidates, asks a yes/no question, then selects a Group and calls action(selected_group). Despite its name, this helper performs selection and the action; do not use it as a legality predicate or inside chk==0.

Declining the yes/no question, having too few candidates, or selecting an empty Group returns numeric 0 without running action. Canceling card selection returns to the yes/no question through RD.CanSelect. Once the player completes a nonempty selection, every callback return value is forwarded unchanged, including no values.
Like RD.SelectAndDoAction, it creates no activation target relation, passes no extra arguments to the filter/action, and emits a selection hint for public-location searches.

params.name: check
params.description: Optional whole-group predicate; pass nil for an ordinary selection.

returns.description: Selected cards; nil on cancellation.

description_zh: 选择卡片组 (功能整合)

functions.name: RushDuel.SelectAndDoAction

params.name: hint
params.description: Selection prompt identifier, such as HINTMSG_TOGRAVE or aux.Stringid(id, n).

params.name: filter
params.description: Card predicate. Include the needed operation-legality checks.

params.name: expect
params.description: Card(s) excluded from matching; pass nil for no exclusion. The upstream parameter is spelled expect.

params.name: action
params.description: Called as action(selected_group) immediately after a nonempty selection.

returns.description: Exactly the callback's return values when invoked; otherwise numeric 0. A callback may return no values.

description_zh: 操作: 选择匹配卡片
description_en: Finds matching cards in the specified locations, asks tp to select a non-cancelable Group of min to max cards, and immediately calls action(selected_group). Use during resolution, not during a chk==0 legality test. This helper does not select activation targets or store a target relation.

The public wrapper passes only a Card to filter and only the selected Group to action; capture other values in closures or compose a filter with RD.Filter. It emits a selection hint for public-location searches. If there are too few candidates or the selected Group is empty, it returns numeric 0 without calling action.

On a nonempty selection it forwards every return value from action unchanged. A callback with no return makes this helper return no values (nil in a single-value assignment); it does not automatically return the selected count or success.
